description: Spontaneous conversions available from any prepared spell of that level — Spontaneous Healer (cure spells) and the druid's built-in Summon Nature's Ally conversion. Not prepared spells themselves; casting one still spends a slot from that level's tracker, except at orison level, which is unlimited-use under this campaign's houserule and never spends anything. The druid Cure progression runs one level higher than cleric/bard past 1st level (cure light wounds stays at 1st, but moderate/serious/critical shift up to 3rd/4th/5th), so 2nd level has no Cure spell at all — only the Summon Nature's Ally conversion.
